quarterly_data.quarter: Aehr Test Systems press release: Aehr Test Systems Expands Silicon Photonics Production (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Aehr received a follow-on production order from its lead silicon photonics wafer-level burn-in customer (not named) for a fully automated FOX-XP multi-wafer production burn-in system to expand the customer's manufacturing capacity for next-generation silicon photonic integrated circuits. The system has nine independent WaferPak test blades, each delivering up to 3,500 watts, for burn-in and reliability screening of silicon photonic ICs used in optical transceivers and emerging chip-to-chip optical I/O, and comes with Aehr's integrated automated wafer handling (WaferPak Auto Aligner, robotic handling, automated loading and unloading). It is expected to ship during the first half of calendar 2027. CEO Gayn Erickson: silicon photonics is 'moving from technology adoption into manufacturing scale-up'; applications are expanding from transceivers into optical switching, co-packaged optics, linear pluggable optics and chip-to-chip optical I/O, with lasers increasingly integrated or co-packaged with the PICs; engagement from silicon photonics companies worldwide has increased meaningfully over the past year and he believes the market is approaching an inflection point.
quarterly_data.figure: one FOX-XP system, nine WaferPak blades at up to 3,500 watts each; ships first half of calendar 2027
